status: prospective foundation contract; not corpus acceptance or Review 2

behavior.ordered_pairs: episode index modulo 4 selects uniform/uniform, uniform/tactical, tactical/uniform, tactical/tactical
behavior.tactical: uniform among immediate winning moves, else moves with no immediate opponent win, else all legal moves; project v28_data.choose_action
behavior.episode_seed: SHA256(contract, corpus seed, role, game, episode index), first 64 bits; numpy default_rng
behavior.episode_bound: 2*board_cells+3 transitions, terminal required; all actions and absolute outcomes replay independently
behavior.ownership: episode has exactly one role before window extraction; symmetry-identical complete episodes cannot cross train/development roles

window_bank.eligibility: exactly four legal transitions ending nonterminal; therefore H1/H2/H4 valid for every selected window, identical across arms
window_bank.terminal_windows: count and exclude from this first balanced bank; do not mislabel missing/terminal targets as valid
window_bank.identity: source ID corpus/role/game/episode/start-ply; content canonical full state/action path plus root-perspective outcome
window_bank.duplicates: collapse canonical content within role/game, retain all source IDs and multiplicity; unit weights one per selected unique content
window_bank.selection: sort unique eligible content IDs by SHA256(corpus seed/role/content ID), take declared fixed per-game cap; no label or model score sorting
window_bank.batches: 32 unique windows per game, deterministic seed/epoch shuffle; 64 total; selected count per game multiple of 32; no sampled replacements
window_bank.targets: recorded action policy and behavior-episode terminal outcome in each current state's player perspective; never solver labels

development_roots.population: one nonterminal late state per original development episode with <=12 C4 empty cells or <=6 Reversi empty cells, >=2 legal own actions
development_roots.selection: minimum SHA256(corpus seed/episode ID/canonical state key); choose before reference solving; preserve no-candidate episodes; no replacement
development_roots.duplicate_roots: first source identity per canonical key retained; all duplicate counts retained, no replacement
development_roots.isolation: root canonical keys excluded from every train/development selected window's root and four future states; whole-tree disjointness is not claimed
development_roots.references: complete legal H2 fork; root-player terminal minimax -1/0/+1; independently implemented bitboard ReferenceGame/ReferenceSolver
development_roots.failure: no partial exact map accepted; failed/no-candidate/duplicate/not-run units remain accounted for
development_roots.criticality: CP-01 v2 nonterminal reference-pairable candidate rule before any model scoring
development_roots.yield_gate: at least five reference-pairable roots per game and >=90% complete references among attempted unique roots; engineering gate only
development_roots.necessary_sign_support_gate: At least two reference-pairable roots/game and >=20% of reference-pairable roots with some control reference difference <2; necessary domain support for nonzero same-sign errors only, not actual model matching

split_audit.shared_openings: enumerated and allowed for train/development behavior; not a disjoint-state claim
split_audit.cross_role_windows: canonical identical window content cannot appear in both roles; deterministic train ownership, exclude development collision and count it
split_audit.eval_root_target_collision: zero required over all selected train/development root/future targets
split_audit.reference_descendant_overlap: report separately if measured; unavailable is missing, not zero
split_audit.support: selected windows and unique roots by game/role; action ID, transition ply and actor; target counts; policy-pair episode counts; all exclusions

locked: generation forbidden before a separate Review 3 manifest binds exact roots/seeds/arms/budget/release; no historical holdout is reused
acceptance: deterministic regeneration identity; independent rules replay at every retained state/action; zero prohibited overlap; selected counts and support audited; complete reference and yield receipt; independent Review 2 before training
storage: raw episodes/windows/roots under ignored chess_data; publish only recipe/source hashes, counts, compact audit receipts and later analysis-ready per-unit results
seed_namespace: counterplay-data-cp01-v1 remains unchanged to regenerate exactly the original episodes

revision.remaining_rule: subtract recorded first batch CPU time before build; charge all regeneration CPU again
revision.stop: No further root screen after this revision. Failure retires the two-game mechanism study before trainer implementation. Preserve original gate failure.
